sentences.en: Far from the grand ambitions declared in Yalta in 1945, Shenzhen felt like a meeting in search of an agenda It is arguably true, given it was the first such meeting of the leaders of China, Russia and the US, that Thursday’s gathering in Shenzhen deserved the description of “historic”.

sentences.en: But in terms of tangible outcomes, it is unlikely to warrant the “new page in the history of diplomacy” that Vladimir Putin claimed had been written, and will instead be consigned to a smallish footnote in any future volume of the 21st century.

items.title: Internet traffic and attacks during the 2026 U.S. midterm elections

sentences.en: Internet traffic and attacks during the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 2026 年美国中期选举期间的互联网流量和攻击。

sentences.en: Visitors to government election websites surged 363% on November 3, the date of the 2026 midterm elections in the United States.
sentences.zh: 11月3日是美国2026年中期选举的投票日，当天政府选举网站的访问量激增363%。

sentences.en: Across Cloudflare's election protection programs, we also detected a significant shift in the types and timing of cyberattacks throughout 2026.
sentences.zh: 在 Cloudflare 的选举保护计划中，我们也发现了 2026 年全年网络攻击的类型和时机发生了重大变化。

sentences.en: Unlike what we saw in other recent elections, attackers focused on gaining access to internal systems and data, rather than knocking websites offline.
sentences.zh: 与其他近期选举不同的是，攻击者专注于获取对内部系统和数据的访问权限，而不是使网站下线。

sentences.en: Government election websites faced website vulnerability attempts 180 times more often than denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, and at roughly ten times the rate of Cloudflare's broader customer base.
sentences.zh: 政府选举网站面临的网站漏洞攻击尝试比拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击的频率高出180倍，比Cloudflare更广泛的客户群的频率高出约10倍。

sentences.en: We also found evidence of at least one attempt to exploit a recently disclosed critical PHP vulnerability on a state government voting website in the Western United States.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现了至少一次试图利用最近披露的严重 PHP 漏洞攻击美国西部某州政府投票网站的证据。

sentences.en: These attacks peaked in late October, several weeks before the election.
sentences.zh: 这些攻击在 10 月下旬达到高峰，距选举还有几周时间。

sentences.en: Vulnerability exploit attempts climbed steadily throughout 2026: from 200,000 per day in January, to 2 million per day in October.
sentences.zh: 2026 年全年，漏洞利用企图稳步攀升：从 1 月的每天 20 万次，到 10 月的每天 200 万次。

sentences.en: However, on Election Day in the U.S., Cloudflare detected no escalation in attack volume and zero major DDoS incidents across protected election sites, marking a sharp contrast to other recent elections, such as in Moldova last year.
sentences.zh: 然而，在美国大选日当天，Cloudflare 未检测到攻击量的增加，且在受保护的选举网站上未发生重大 DDoS 事件，这与其他近期选举（如去年在摩尔多瓦举行的选举）形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: Our data regarding cyberattacks on election institutions came from organizations participating in Cloudflare's free cybersecurity programs: the Athenian Project , Cloudflare for Campaigns , and Project Galileo .
sentences.zh: 我们有关选举机构遭受网络攻击的数据来自参与 Cloudflare 免费网络安全计划的组织：雅典计划、Cloudflare for Campaigns 和伽利略计划。

sentences.en: Together, these initiatives helped protect more than 1,400 election-related websites during the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, including those belonging to state and local governments, candidates, political parties, voting-rights advocates, journalists, and civil society groups.
sentences.zh: 这些举措共同帮助在2026年美国中期选举期间保护了1400多个与选举相关的网站，包括属于州和地方政府、候选人、政党、投票权倡导者、记者和民间社会团体的网站。

sentences.en: Cloudflare launched its first election protection program in 2016 after widespread reports of cyberattacks targeting the U.S. elections.
sentences.zh: 2016 年，在针对美国大选的网络攻击被广泛报道后，Cloudflare 启动了首个选举保护计划。

sentences.zh: 联合国人口基金会发现，在西非和中非，近一半的女性无法拒绝同意，其中受影响最严重的是女孩。根据联合国的一份报告，在全球范围内，每四名女性中就有一名在丈夫或伴侣要求性行为时无权拒绝同意。

sentences.en: In west and central Africa, almost half of women (45%) are not able to say no in their own marriage, while a third of women (33%) in east and southern Africa and in Arab states face the same predicament.
sentences.zh: 在西非和中非，近一半的妇女（45%）在自己的婚姻中无法拒绝，而在东非和南部非洲以及阿拉伯国家，三分之一的妇女（33%）面临同样的困境。

sentences.en: In Latin America and the Caribbean, one in 10 women are not able to refuse sex, said the report by the UN Population Fund ( UNFPA ) published on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 联合国人口基金（UNFPA）周四发布的报告称，在拉丁美洲和加勒比地区，每10名女性中就有一名无法拒绝性行为。

items.title: Florida pastor found guilty over 2021 assassination of Haitian president

sentences.en: Florida pastor found guilty over 2021 assassination of Haitian president.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州牧师因2021年海地总统遇刺案被判有罪。

sentences.en: Christian Emmanuel Sanon faces life in prison after conviction on charges arising from killing of Jovenel Moïse A Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship was convicted on Wednesday of US charges arising from the 2021 assassination of the Haitian president Jovenel Moïse.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂安·埃马纽埃尔·萨农因被控谋杀若弗内尔·莫伊兹而被判刑，面临终身监禁。这位拥有海地和美国双重国籍的佛罗里达牧师于周三因2021年海地总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺一案而被美国定罪。

sentences.en: Christian Emmanuel Sanon was found guilty on charges including conspiring to kill Moïse after a nearly eight-week trial in federal court in Miami.
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密联邦法院历时近八周的审判中，克里斯蒂安·埃马纽埃尔·萨农（Christian Emmanuel Sanon）被裁定犯有包括密谋刺杀莫伊兹在内的多项罪名。

sentences.en: He had faced a total of eight charges including conspiracy to kidnap or kill a person outside the United States.
sentences.zh: 他总共面临八项指控，包括密谋在美国境外绑架或杀害他人。

items.title: An updated Clairic and Clairic-flash are now open-weight, from the new Workers AI Superintelligence team

sentences.en: An updated Clairic and Clairic-flash are now open-weight, from the new Workers AI Superintelligence team.
sentences.zh: 来自全新Workers AI超级智能团队的Clairic和Clairic-flash现已更新为开放权重。

sentences.en: Cloudflare has become a neolab.
We’re building our own frontier AI models for our customers and the open-source community.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为我们的客户和开源社区构建我们自己的前沿人工智能模型。

sentences.en: Today, we’re announcing two open-weight model releases: We’re introducing an updated version of Clairic .
Since the preview, we’ve improved extraction from complex documents including images and PDFs (new!)
, with more reliable handling of tables, lists, and dates, and better grounding of answers in the source material.
We’re introducing Clairic-flash , a lighter, faster version of Clairic that delivers strong extraction and prediction performance in a compact, 9-billion-parameter model.
Both extraction models are hosted on Workers AI and full open weights are available on Hugging Face .
We’re also excited to re-introduce ourselves as the Workers AI superintelligence team, the frontier AI research team behind Clef , Clairic, and lots more in the works.
This team is working quickly to push the AI frontier and build useful models for Cloudflare’s customers and the open source community.

A new version of Clairic: redesigned after the preview release Since announcing Clairic in preview, we have received a ton of use cases and helpful feedback on how customers wanted to use an extraction model.
We heard about use cases ranging from extracting data from images like receipts to reading values from support tickets.

items.title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military

sentences.en: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military.
sentences.zh: 黑格塞斯利用对委内瑞拉的访问来吹嘘美国军方将逮捕马杜罗。

sentences.en: Defense secretary asserts US dominance on trip that would have seemed ‘impossible, almost unbelievable’ a year ago Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”.
sentences.zh: 美国国防部长在访问中宣称美国占据主导地位，而这一访问在一年以前似乎“不可能，几乎难以置信”皮特·赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）利用自美国特种部队绑架委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗（Nicolás Maduro）以来的首次委内瑞拉之行，吹嘘在一次他所称的“拉丁美洲历史上最复杂的军事行动”中抓获了这位独裁者。

sentences.en: Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.
sentences.zh: 1月3日凌晨，马杜罗被三角洲特种部队的特工以有争议的方式抓获，这引发了华盛顿与委内瑞拉自1999年以来执政的反帝国主义“查韦斯主义”政权之间不可能的和解。

items.title: AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances

sentences.en: AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances.
sentences.zh: AWS Lambda 现在支持 Lambda 托管实例上的事件函数使用 GPU 实例。

sentences.en: GPU support is now available for EC2 G-series GPU instances for Event Functions running on AWS Lambda Managed Instances (LMI).
sentences.zh: 现在，对于在AWS Lambda托管实例（LMI）上运行的事件函数，EC2 G系列GPU实例提供GPU支持。

sentences.en: You can now run GPU-accelerated workloads, including machine learning inference, media processing, rendering, and scientific computing, on GPU instances with serverless simplicity.
sentences.zh: 现在，您可以在 GPU 实例上以无服务器的简洁方式运行 GPU 加速的工作负载，包括机器学习推理、媒体处理、渲染和科学计算。

sentences.en: GPU-accelerated functions are deployed as container (Open Container Initiative, OCI) images.
sentences.zh: GPU 加速函数以容器（开放容器计划，OCI）镜像的形式部署。

sentences.en: You build an OCI image, point the function at it, and let Lambda handle provisioning, scaling, and event integration.
sentences.zh: 您构建一个OCI镜像，将函数指向该镜像，然后让Lambda处理预置、扩展和事件集成。

sentences.en: There are no GPU drivers, CUDA versions, or AMIs to reconcile, and no clusters or device plugins to operate.
sentences.zh: 无需协调 GPU 驱动程序、CUDA 版本或 AMI，也无需操作集群或设备插件。

sentences.en: GPU-accelerated functions run on the same Lambda Managed Instances foundation that already gives you Amazon EC2 pricing and specialized compute without managing servers.
sentences.zh: GPU 加速函数在与您已经享用 Amazon EC2 定价和专用计算的同一 Lambda 托管实例基础上运行，无需管理服务器。

sentences.en: Why customers need this Customers keep asking to run GPU workloads with the simplicity of serverless.
sentences.zh: 为什么客户需要这项服务？客户一直在要求以无服务器的简便性来运行 GPU 工作负载。

sentences.en: Building on self-managed GPU infrastructure means selecting instances, installing and reconciling GPU drivers and CUDA libraries, planning capacity, writing scaling logic, and hand-building the event integrations that connect the GPU step to the rest of the application.
sentences.zh: 在自管GPU基础设施的基础上进行构建意味着需要选择实例、安装和协调GPU驱动程序和CUDA库、规划容量、编写扩展逻辑，以及手动构建将GPU步骤与应用程序的其余部分连接起来的事件集成。

sentences.en: Serverless GPU services that hide that work often sit outside your AWS environment, with no native event sources, identity, or networking.
sentences.zh: 隐藏该工作的无服务器 GPU 服务通常位于您的 AWS 环境之外，没有原生事件源、身份或联网。

sentences.en: Cost is the second problem.
sentences.zh: 成本是第二个问题。

sentences.en: GPUs are expensive, and utilization is usually low because a single workload rarely saturates a GPU.
sentences.zh: GPU 价格昂贵，利用率通常较低，因为单个工作负载很少能使 GPU 饱和。

items.title: Apec summit as it happened: Xi welcomes Trump on China visit as Putin claims Europe in ‘humiliating decline’

sentences.en: Apec summit as it happened: Xi welcomes Trump on China visit as Putin claims Europe in ‘humiliating decline’.
sentences.zh: 亚太经合组织峰会实况报道：习近平欢迎特朗普访华，普京称欧洲正处于“屈辱的衰落”之中。

sentences.en: This blog is now closed, you can read more on this story here Yalta became a byword for betrayal.
sentences.zh: 此博客现已关闭，您可以在此处阅读有关此故事的更多内容：雅尔塔成为背叛的代名词。

sentences.en: Will Trump, Xi and Putin enact another carve-up?
sentences.zh: 特朗普、习近平和普京会再次瓜分世界吗？

sentences.en: That is the question the Guardian’s diplomatic correspondent Patrick Wintour seeks to address in his piece about the expected, Putin, Trump and Xi, meeting at Apec on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 这是《卫报》外交记者帕特里克·温图尔（Patrick Wintour）在其关于周四亚太经合组织（APEC）会议上普京、特朗普和习近平预计将举行的会晤的文章中试图回答的问题。

sentences.en: It is a truism in diplomacy that if you are not around the table, the risk is that you, or your values, are on the menu and about to be carved up.
sentences.zh: 在外交领域，有一句老生常谈的话：如果你不在谈判桌上，那么你或你的价值观就有可能成为谈判的议题，并被他人瓜分。

sentences.en: Many excluded from the summit in Shenzhen, principally Ukraine but also eastern Europe and Baltic countries, Taiwan and even Iran, have reason to be nervous that their sponsors might abandon them in a complex geopolitical trade-off that Putin envisions, and Trump seems to endorse.
sentences.zh: 许多被排除在深圳峰会之外的国家，主要是乌克兰，但也包括东欧和波罗的海国家、台湾，甚至伊朗，都有理由感到紧张，担心他们的支持者可能会在普京设想、且特朗普似乎赞同的复杂地缘政治权衡中抛弃他们。
